title: Can LLMs Faithfully Solve Ontology Engineering Tasks? A Mechanistic Interpretability Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.38326v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ontological knowledge underpins large language model (LLM) performance on knowledge-intensive tasks. However, existing evaluations of LLMs' ontological understanding largely rely on behavioral correctness, leaving the underlying mechanisms unexplained. Existing mechanistic interpretability work has largely focused on instance-level factual knowledge, leaving ontological knowledge under-explored. To bridge this gap, we introduce MIOE, a causal-abstraction benchmark that evaluates interchange interventions for two ontology engineering tasks: entity typing and subsumption prediction. MIOE tests whether learned internal intervention targets can change an ontology-level target answer while preserving class-specific auxiliary information. Across Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-4B, we evaluate SAE-, DBM-, and DAS-based methods, including multi-task and multi-layer variants. Distributed subspace methods give the strongest results and generalize across prompt

translated_title: 大语言模型能否忠实地解决本体工程任务？一项机制可解释性研究
translated_abstract: 本体知识是大语言模型（LLM）在知识密集型任务上表现的基础。然而，现有对 LLM 本体理解能力的评估主要依赖于行为层面的正确性，而未能揭示其背后的内在机制。同时，现有的机制可解释性研究大多聚焦于实例级别的事实性知识，对本体知识的探索仍显不足。为弥合这一空白，我们提出了 MIOE——一个因果抽象基准，用于评估两种本体工程任务上的交换干预：实体类型化和包含关系预测。MIOE 检验学习到的内部干预目标能否在保留类特定辅助信息的同时改变本体层面的目标答案。我们在 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-4B 上评估了基于 SAE、DBM 和 DAS 的方法，包括多任务和多层变体。结果表明，分布式子空间方法取得了最强的效果，并能跨提示进行泛化。
tldr: 该论文提出了 MIOE——一个用于探究大语言模型内部机制能否忠实地解决本体工程任务（实体类型化与包含关系预测）的因果抽象基准，并发现分布式子空间干预方法效果最强且具有跨提示的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MIOE, a causal-abstraction benchmark that probes whether LLMs' internal mechanisms faithfully solve ontology engineering tasks (entity typing and subsumption prediction), finding that distributed subspace intervention methods achieve the strongest and most generalizable results.
